name: Period tracker
description: Log your period and get a heads-up before it's due.
title: Period tracker
dayLockedPast: This day is in the past, so it's locked. Tap to make changes.
dayUnlockedHint: Unlocked for editing. Tap to lock this day again.
approaching_one: Period may arrive in about {{count}} day
approaching_other: Period may arrive in about {{count}} days
due: Your period should be coming soon.
remindersDescription: Saved on this device only, like the diary's other reminders.
reminderDescription: A notice a couple of days before your period is predicted to start.
reminderBody: Your period may be arriving soon
emptyPageDescription: Add a past period below, or mark one from the diary's day page once it starts.
deleteCycleDescription: This removes every day recorded for it. There is no undo.
addPeriodDescription: Choose the days it covered. Every day defaults to a medium flow — expand to set each one individually.
editPeriodDescription: Adjust the days it covered, or fine-tune the intensity of any of them.

cycle.title: Log a period
cycle.lede: Add a past period from its own page, then fine-tune the flow of any day inside it.
cycle.previewNote: Just a preview — nothing here is saved.

day.title: A heads-up on the day page
day.lede: A few days before one's due, the day page says so — and once it's here, records it in two taps.

calendar.title: See it on the calendar
calendar.lede: Logged days shade darker the heavier the flow; a predicted window shades lighter than anything actually recorded, until it is.
